stories.summary: With Hyderabad recording an Air Quality Index (AQI) of over 300 on Deepavali and many other days recording poor air quality earlier this year, doctors and public health experts have called for a coordinated effort by hospitals to track the health effects of pollution and build a city-level database that can help shape public policy.

stories.title: Chinese medical delegation visits Jayadeva, St. Martha’s hospitals
stories.summary: A 15-member delegation of medical specialists from Guizhou Medical University in China visited the State-run Sri Jayadeva Institute of Cardiovascular Sciences and Research on Thursday as part of the Dr. Kotnis Memorial India-China Medical Mission 7. The team also visited St. Martha’s Hospital in Bengaluru on Friday. The visit was aimed at exploring opportunities for healthcare cooperation and knowledge exchange between the two countries.

stories.title: Mehul Choksi Denies Fleeing To Evade Prosecution Like Nephew Nirav Modi: 'Left India For Medical Reasons'
stories.summary: Choksi's lawyers have submitted written arguments before the special court hearing the application filed by the Enforcement Directorate (ED) seeking to declare Choksi a Fugitive Economic Offender (FEO). The same court is also hearing both cases of alleged Punjab National Bank (PNB) fraud registered by the CBI against Modi and Choksi, as well as the connected money laundering cases being probed by the ED.

stories.title: Lung cancer: Doctors call for risk-based screening as cases rise
stories.summary: Lung cancer is now the leading cause of cancer deaths in India, and who it affects is changing. 12 lakh in 2024, while deaths climbed from around 75,000 to 98,687 over the same period, according to data from the Global Cancer Observatory, maintained by the WHO’s International Agency for Research on Cancer.

stories.title: Catherine joins cancer support group in new documentary
stories.summary: "I haven't really explored this outside my family walls," Catherine tells a group of people from Shine Cancer Support. The documentary features her personal thoughts on her illness and recovery. Catherine has never disclosed what type of cancer she faced, but in March 2024 she revealed that she had a diagnosis of cancer and was receiving chemotherapy.

stories.title: Sharad Pawar admitted to hospital in south Mumbai due to dehydration
stories.summary: National Congress party (Sharadchandra Pawar) supremo Sharad Pawar has been admitted to Mumbai’s Breach Candy hospital over “dehydration” on Thursday (November 26, 2026). Mr. Pawar’s daughter and NCP-SP MP Supriya Sule informed on X, saying “We are admitting Baba to Breach Candy Hospital. It appears to be dehydration.”

stories.title: Men's Health Awareness Month 2026 highlights why men delay check-ups; a physician warns that ignoring health can have dire consequences
stories.summary: Men often postpone routine health check-ups, sometimes until symptoms become severe enough to disrupt their daily lives. This behaviour is influenced by several factors, including busy work schedules, family responsibilities, fear of medical diagnoses, lack of awareness, and the belief that feeling physically fit means being healthy.

stories.title: Lionel Messi's Inter Miami crash out of MLS Cup playoffs as title defence ends
stories.summary: Columbus, who entered the playoffs as the seventh seed, completed a 2-0 series sweep to book their place in the Eastern Conference semifinals. Inter Miami, the second seed in the Eastern Conference, had their backs against the wall heading into Saturday's encounter. They needed a win to stay in contention and take the series to a third and decisive match at home.

stories.title: Ben Stokes dethroned! Rishabh Pant creates history in Christchurch
stories.summary: Rishabh Pant added another record to his name during the second Test against New Zealand in Christchurch on Saturday. Pant reached the landmark on Day 2 of the ongoing Test when he hit New Zealand pacer Jacob Duffy for a six during India's first innings. Pant goes past Ben StokesPant needed just one six to move ahead of Stokes and achieved the feat in the 25th over of India's innings.

stories.title: IND vs NZ 2nd Test: Akash Deep's Five-Wicket Heroics Goes In Vain As Kyle Jamieson And Jacob Duffy Leave India Reeling At 116/6 On Day 2
stories.summary: BCCI/X New Zealand took firm control of the second Test against India after leaving the visitors reeling at 116/6 at stumps on Day 2 here at Hagley Oval here on Saturday, having extended their first-innings total to 356 through valuable lower-order contributions.

stories.title: Will O'Rourke returns to New Zealand squad for Test tour of Australia
stories.summary: Akash Deep (4/84) continued to be India’s shining light with the ball, adding two wickets to his overnight tally of two. But New Zealand’s lower order rallied around a resolute Tom Blundell to strengthen the hosts’ position in the first session of Day Two of the second Test at Hagley Oval on Saturday.

stories.title: Australia drop Lyon for New Zealand Tests
stories.summary: Cricket Correspondent Published 27 November 2026, 12:24 GMT Australia are set to drop off-spinner Nathan Lyon for the first Test against New Zealand, with uncapped Corey Rocchiccioli expected to be named in the squad. The omission of Lyon for the Test in Perth from 9-13 December is not thought to be linked to the sandpaper controversy.

stories.title: 39 Naga Ancestral Remains Return Home After Nearly A Century In UK
stories.summary: Thirty-nine Naga ancestral human remains, repatriated from the Pitt Rivers Museum in the United Kingdom after more than a century, arrived in Nagaland on Friday, marking the culmination of a six-year effort to bring the remains home for a dignified burial.

stories.title: India vs New Zealand | Visitors stumble at Christchurch after Akash Deep's five-wicket haul
stories.summary: India stumbled to 116 for six in their first innings against New Zealand at stumps on the second day of the second cricket Test at Christchurch, still trailing by 240 runs. Opener KL Rahul (25), Devdutt Padikkal (21), Rishabh Pant (23) and skipper Shubman Gill (17) all got starts but could not convert those into substantial knocks on Saturday.

stories.title: India vs New Zealand Highlights 2nd Test Day 2: IND reeling at 116/6; trail by 240 runs
stories.summary: New Zealand celebrate the wicket of Rishabh Pant Follow every twist and turn of the Christchurch Test with our Ball-by-Ball Commentary and keep track of the latest scores on our Live Scorecard . IND vs NZ, 2nd Test Day 2 Highlights: Akash Deep's five-wicket haul headlined India's bowling effort as New Zealand were bowled out for 356 on Day 2 in Christchurch.

stories.title: Jamie Overton tears through Australia in rain-hit T20 as England seize series lead
stories.summary: England all-rounder Jamie Overton claimed a maiden international five-wicket haul as the tourists beat Australia by seven wickets under the DLS method in a rain-hit match at the Gabba on Friday to move 2-1 ahead in the five-match Twenty20 series.

stories.title: 'Leader Brother Mentor': Surya's special message as Rohit returns as MI captain
stories.summary: Hours after Mumbai Indians announced Rohit's reinstatement as captain on Friday, Suryakumar took to Instagram Stories to react to the development. In his first Instagram Story, Suryakumar reposted Mumbai Indians' announcement of Rohit's appointment and added six blue heart emojis. He followed it up with another repost, accompanied by the message: "Leader Brother Mentor.

stories.title: How a football team rebuilt after 19 players died in plane crash
stories.summary: It was 2am when Ivan Tozzo picked up his mobile phone and heard his football club's secretary screaming his name. Seventy-one people were dead, including 19 of 22 players from the Brazilian club who were on their way to the biggest game in their history.

stories.title: IPL 2027: Rohit Sharma back in the saddle for Mumbai Indians
stories.summary: Rohit Sharma, three years after being stripped of captaincy, has been reinstated as Mumbai Indians skipper for the Indian Premier League 2027, returning to the role in which he led the franchise to all five of its IPL titles. After trading Hardik Pandya, who led the side for three seasons, to Punjab Kings, Mumbai has turned to the man behind its most successful era.

stories.title: Asian Champions Trophy: India outclass Malaysia, set up final against China
stories.summary: Defending champions India produced a commanding display to defeat Malaysia 6–2 in the semi-final of the women's Asian Champions Trophy at the International Sports Complex in Bhopal on Friday, securing their place in the final for a sixth time. Tournament's top scorer Deepika Sehrawat scored twice, while Mumtaz Khan, Navneet Kaur, Sunelita Toppo and Ishika found the mark once each.

stories.title: Head coach Slegers leaves Arsenal 18 months after Champions League win
stories.summary: Arsenal have parted company with head coach Renee Slegers by mutual consent after a disappointing start to the season. Slegers, 37, was initially appointed on an interim basis in October 2024 before being handed the role permanently three months later. The Dutchwoman led Arsenal to their second Women's Champions League title in May 2025 and the inaugural Fifa Women's Champions Cup in February 2026.

stories.title: Rohit Sharma back as Mumbai Indians captain; five-time winner to lead MI in IPL 2027
stories.summary: Rohit Sharma will return as Mumbai Indians captain for the 2027 Indian Premier League (IPL) season, the franchise announced on Friday. The announcement comes following Hardik Pandya's trade to Punjab Kings (PBKS) ahead of the IPL 2027 auction next month. Hardik had replaced Rohit as Mumbai Indians captain ahead of the 2024 season, following his return to the franchise from Gujarat Titans.

stories.title: ‘Nothing comes before our nation’: Khushbu Sundar backs Jo Bachay Hain Sang Samait Lo ban
stories.summary: Her remarks come amid controversy over the proposed release of the Netflix series, starring Fawad Khan and Mahira Khan. The Ministry of Information and Broadcasting has reminded Netflix that content originating in Pakistan must not be streamed in India and asked the platform to comply with its advisory issued on May 8, 2025.

stories.title: World chess championship: Sindarov admits Gukesh out-prepared him in third game
stories.summary: Challenger Javokhir Sindarov admitted he was out-prepared by defending champion D Gukesh in the third game of the World Chess Championship in Geneva, as the Indian's opening preparation put the Uzbek under pressure. 5 after three consecutive draws, Sindarov acknowledged that Gukesh, who was playing with Black pieces in Game 3, had caught him off guard with his preparation in the opening.

stories.title: Virat Kohli recalls watching India's landmark Brisbane Test win in 2021 from hospital during birth of his child
stories.summary: The Border-Gavaskar Trophy in India will start in January next year. After losing the previous BGT series in Aussie conditions last year, Team India would be vying to take back the trophy. With the Test team growing in experience, they could take a lot of inspiration from an Indian side from the final Gabba Test five years back, which was practically a second-string side with several key players out due to injuries.

stories.title: Syed Mushtaq Ali Trophy: Azharuddeen’s century powers Kerala into the Super League
stories.summary: Mohammed Azharuddeen’s signature rocking-the-bat celebration has become a defining moment in this season’s Syed Mushtaq Ali Trophy T20 cricket tournament. The opening batter brought it out once again on Friday for his second T20 hundred (101, 57b, 8x4, 6x6) which dismantled Himachal Pradesh and helped Kerala register a 67-run win to qualify for the Super League.

stories.title: Syed Modi Int'l: Treesa Jolly-Gayatri Gopichand enter QF
stories.summary: Indian shuttlers made strong progress at the Syed Modi India International World Tour Super 300 Badminton Championships here on Thursday. However, the tournament’s biggest upsets came at the expense of the men’s singles top seed and two leading Indian mixed doubles pairs. Defending champions and top seeds Gayatri Gopichand and Treesa Jolly continued their winning run, while four Indian women’s singles players advanced to the quarter-finals.

stories.title: Rishabh Pant sets record for most sixes in World Test Championship
stories.summary: India batter Rishabh Pant set the record for the most sixes in World Test Championship history on Saturday. Pant reached the milestone with a six over mid on off Jacob Duffy’s bowling on Day 2 of the second Test between India and New Zealand on Saturday. It marked Pant’s 89th maximum since the inaugural WTC cycle began on August 1, 2019.

stories.title: 'Siraj needs help': Ashwin urges India team to show compassion after repeated snubs
stories.summary: Ravichandran Ashwin has urged the Indian team management and players to show compassion towards Mohammed Siraj following the fast bowler's consecutive omissions from the playing XI in the two-Test series against New Zealand. Drawing from his own experience, Ashwin stressed that such difficult phases can affect players differently and that having a sports psychologist around could make a significant difference.

stories.title: IND vs NZ 2nd Test: Akash Deep triggers New Zealand collapse, but Tom Blundell leads fightback against In
stories.summary: Two absences made their presence felt at Hagley Oval on Friday: Pacer Mohammed Siraj from India’s playing XI, again, and, more alarmingly, the usual magic, speed and spark in spearhead Jasprit Bumrah’s bowling. Despite India keeping the Kiwi batters on a tight leash for large portions of the day, they will still wonder if the advantage of winning the toss and bowling first on a greenish pitch has been squandered.

stories.title: Man Utd trigger Fernandes' one-year contract extension
stories.summary: Manchester United reporter Published 4 minutes ago Manchester United have triggered their one-year option on captain Bruno Fernandes' contract. The 32-year-old's deal was due to expire next summer but sources with an understanding of the situation say both parties decided it was in their best interests to trigger the option.

stories.title: Yashasvi Jaiswal overtakes Virat Kohli for unwanted WTC record
stories.summary: Yashasvi Jaiswal faced a disappointing dismissal, falling for a six-ball duck against New Zealand in Christchurch. This dismissal made him the Indian batter with the most ducks in World Test Championship history. Previously, Jaiswal had scored an impressive 85 runs in the opening Test against New Zealand in Wellington.

stories.title: Why the Supreme Court wants red warning labels on unhealthy packaged foods | Explained
stories.summary: Packaged food products high in sugar, saturated fat or salt could soon carry prominent red warning labels on the front of their packs, alerting consumers to their nutritional content. The Supreme Court, earlier this week, directed the Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI) to introduce a single-phase front-of-pack nutrition labelling (FoPNL) regime and gave the regulator four months to finalise the draft regulations.

stories.title: Why COP31 was more than a failure of negotiations
stories.summary: The immediate trigger was a “cover text” put forward by COP 31 president Murat Kurum, Turkiye’s Environment Minister. This is an overarching political decision that frames the outcome of a conference and is usually finalised last. Like every outcome, it needs the agreement of all parties. No country or bloc holds a veto but every clause must be accepted by all 190-plus delegations.

stories.title: Is Russia about to launch a nuclear weapon into Earth’s orbit? A space law expert explains the threat | Hindustan Times
stories.summary: Sydney, As early as December. That's how soon Russia could put a satellite carrying a nuclear weapon in orbit, according to German media reports. If the news sounds familiar from headlines past, that's because it is. In 2024, the United States made a similar allegation, albeit without giving any potential launch window.

stories.title: Delimitation explained: Will southern states lose political power? The numbers behind the 50% Lok Sabha expansion
stories.summary: The Union Cabinet on Friday approved a proposal to increase the strength of the Lok Sabha by 50% across all states, while keeping their existing relative share of parliamentary seats unchanged until the first Census conducted after 2051. The decision comes ahead of a special sitting of Parliament, called by the government from November 30 to December 3, Hindustan Times reported.

stories.title: 50% more seats, bigger state assemblies: Five changes in the new delimitation bills | HT Explainers
stories.summary: The delimitation bills cleared by the Union Cabinet on Friday would add 50% to every state’s and Union territory’s Lok Sabha seats, and to every assembly, while each state’s share of the Lok Sabha would remain the same. The bills say the increase is meant to give women’s reservation immediate effect.

stories.title: Do Indian bodies burn calories differently? Country’s 1st advanced metabolic chamber seeks answers
stories.summary: The Human Metabolic Chamber at Vellore’s Christian Medical College (CMC) was jointly established by the college and the Tata Institute of Fundamental Research’s (TIFR) Advanced Research Unit on Metabolism, Development and Aging (ARUMDA) and is designed to give researchers a more precise picture of how the human body burns calories and uses different sources of energy.

stories.title: Mint explainer: why HPV vaccination is critical for girls as India crosses 10 million doses
stories.summary: India has administered more than 10 million doses of the human papillomavirus (HPV) vaccine to 14-year-old girls in less than nine months under a campaign by the Union health ministry. The drive has covered nearly 87% of the annual target cohort of about 12 million girls, drawing praise from the World Health Organization’s (WHO) South-East Asia Region.

stories.title: Do India's reasons for dropping Mohammed Siraj in New Zealand Tests stand up to scrutiny?
stories.summary: The stories on the opening day of the two-match Test series between New Zealand and India were dominated by the names missing from the team sheet rather than those on it. Ravindra Jadeja and Mohammed Siraj, with a combined experience of 139 Tests, were deemed surplus to requirements for the playing eleven.

stories.title: Netanyahu may offer rival rotating PM deal amid coalition uncertainty; will Eisenkot accept? | Explained
stories.summary: Weeks after Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu lost the country's election to his rival, Yashar chairman Gadi Eisenkot, the former is reportedly preparing to offer his rival the position of prime minister in a rotational government, local media reported. According to The Times of Israel , Netanyahu is willing to serve as the second prime minister.

stories.title: What is the Indraprastha Communique issued after SCO Civilizational Forum in New Delhi? | Explained
stories.summary: India hosted the first “Civilisational Dialogue Forum” of the 10-nation Shanghai Cooperation Organisation (SCO) grouping, that includes Pakistan, from November 20-22 at Delhi’s historic Purana Qila. The dialogue, which was organized by the Ministry of Culture and the Ministry of External Affairs, was proposed by Prime Minister Narendra Modi at the SCO leaders’ Summit in Tianjin last year and adopted by the SCO Council.

stories.title: Explained: What is delimitation? Why is the Bill pending, and what is the debate about?
stories.summary: As the four-day special sitting brings the spotlight back on the delimitation debate, here’s an explainer on how Parliamentary and Assembly constituencies are redrawn following such an exercise. Delimitation is the act or process of fixing limits or boundaries of territorial constituencies in a country or a province having a legislative body.

stories.title: Explained: What is ‘Starmind’? SpaceX gets FCC nod for 1 million space-based data centres - Full details
stories.summary: SpaceX has received approval from the US Federal Communications Commission (FCC) to deploy up to 1 million orbital computing modules for a proposed constellation of space-based data centres, marking a major push to take artificial intelligence (AI) infrastructure beyond Earth.

stories.title: 500+ cops to be deployed at Diljit Dosanjh's Mumbai concert following bomb threat email
stories.summary: Bomb Detection and Disposal Squad teams have swept the venue, adding that entry checks will be carried out across all five gates instead of three.
